summary: Make guest-open public access and explicitly public safe actions a mandatory inherited rule for every current and future EKODI user-facing service, workspace public site and independent EKODI site, while preserving authentication for private, paid, privileged, operator and administrator capabilities.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly instructed on 2026-10-02 that the rule must apply not only to EKODI Mission but to every EKODI Platform user and independent site as a common forced execution rule.
implementation: PUBLIC-INTERACTION-001 safe public action contract in governance/constitution/constitution.json
merge-blocking checks in scripts/validate-constitution.mjs and scripts/validate-user-surfaces.mjs
mandatoryRules: all current and future canonical public user sites are guest-open by default
independent EKODI sites and workspace public sites inherit the same rule without service-local override
explicitly public event applications, reservation requests, inquiries, feedback/opinion and interest registration do not require login
login may enhance public actions with prefill, history, status or member benefits but may not be required solely for submission
private data, restricted writes/applications, payments, uploads, protected downloads, operator/admin, privilege-changing and account-security actions remain authenticated
public guest actions require input validation, abuse protection, data minimization, required consent and verified persistence before success
public guest actions may never grant privilege, expose protected data or write across private workspace boundaries
rollback: Revert Constitution v1.27.0, workspace inheritance metadata, runtime public access contract and related validators through the guarded C2 path to v1.26.1. Preserve existing public pages and already-safe anonymous application flows while rollback is evaluated; do not introduce broad public writes or weaken admin/private protections.
